mechanism: UTC-hour / market-wide-RV conditioning of the funding effect applied to OBSERVED LIQUIDATION INTENSITY (RESEARCH_PROMPT.md section 16 contingency ladder, mechanism 1, estimand transplanted from FCLR-XSEC-002)
distinct_from: FCLR-STARTER-001 (time-series 24h forward RV forecast, verdict NOT_SUPPORTED)
FCLR-XSEC-001 (pooled within-hour cross-sectional funding contrast on RV, verdict NOT_SUPPORTED)
FCLR-XSEC-002 (regime-conditioned funding contrast on next-hour RV, verdict SUPPORTED)
FCLR-XSEC-003 (thin RV-only holdout, SUPERSEDED, never executed)
FCLR-LIQ-COMBINED-PANEL (time-series 24h liquidation intensity QLIKE C2 vs B1, NOT_MET)
TRACKA-HL-LIQ-XSEC (pooled cross-sectional funding IC on ironflow, EXPLORATORY_NULL)
regime_variable: market-wide RV at hour t = cross-sectional mean of coin rv24h at t across coins present in hour t
regime_split_primary: high vs low tercile of market-wide RV (middle tercile excluded); hours with fewer than 3 coins present are excluded from regime eligibility
predictor_primary: abs_fund_pct within-(hour,regime) cross-sectional rank; high_funding = top half of coins by rank, low_funding = bottom half within the same (hour, regime)
outcome_primary: next-hour observed liquidation intensity per coin = sum of notional_usd over all observed liquidation events of that coin in the closed UTC hour t+1 (shift -1 within coin)
outcome_secondary: next-hour observed liquidation event count per coin (count-based robustness of the same contrast)
baseline: within-regime RV persistence (coin's own rv24h at t split high/low within (hour, regime)) predicting next-hour liquidation intensity — specificity control
family: regimes x {funding contrast, RV persistence baseline} = 2 regimes x 2 contrasts
materiality_definition: abs(mean_diff_high_minus_low) / mean_abs_outcome over the regime's coin-hours, where mean_abs_outcome is the mean absolute next-hour liquidation intensity across the regime's coin-hours

constraints.track_separation: observed liquidations (Track A / this campaign) are never conflated with modeled boundary breaches (Track B) or with RV forecasts
